what: Mistake: on 13 Nov I logged (20261113-132803-knm6) and told Sri that a writer ran 90 min past an unenforced 616 s deadline. The steward found (work item 20261114-022805-2xbq) that 616 s was the leftover time after a login-expiry retry on a 5400 s cap; the limit was not broken.
why: I read the stop reason's deadline number at face value without checking the job's configured cap or its retry history.
